suite: Suite PR #555 (Pipeline & Line Sizing Studio Full precision switch, stacked on #554)

beginner.append: Read the figures in the Pipeline & Line Sizing Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
beginner.why: The Studio card rounds f to 4 decimals and the drops to 1 against tolerances of 1e-9 and 1e-5.

imo1_friction_factor.display_ref: src/components/linesizing/SizingPanel.jsx:36 Friction factor, formatFull(sizing.f, 10) with Full precision on
imo1_friction_factor.evidence: With Full precision on, the liquid Selected line card prints the friction factor at 10 decimals (jest: SizingPanel.fullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

imo1_friction_drop_psi.display_ref: src/components/linesizing/SizingPanel.jsx:29-31 Friction drop (shown only with Full precision on), engine dpFrictionPsi at 6 dp
imo1_friction_drop_psi.evidence: With Full precision on, a Friction drop stat prints the engine friction term at 6 decimals (jest: SizingPanel.fullPrecision.test.jsx).

imo1_total_drop_psi.display_ref: src/components/linesizing/SizingPanel.jsx:28 Pressure drop at 6 dp with Full precision on
imo1_total_drop_psi.evidence: With Full precision on, Pressure drop prints at 6 decimals (jest: SizingPanel.fullPrecision.test.jsx).

intermediate.append: Read the figures in the Pipeline & Line Sizing Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
intermediate.why: The gas card rounds the outlet pressure to 1 decimal against a tolerance of 1e-5.

brass_outlet_pressure_psia.evidence: With Full precision on, the gas card prints the outlet pressure at 6 decimals (jest: SizingPanel.fullPrecision.test.jsx).
